# Digital coworkers: How AI agents are reshaping enterprise teams
## How AI agents are shifting from tools to digital coworkers
Unlike traditional rule-based automation tools, these digital colleagues have the autonomy and awareness to carry out complex tasks without constant human supervision.

## **Frequently asked questions**
A digital AI agent is an autonomous software system that acts as a coworker by monitoring conditions, making decisions, and coordinating tasks across departments without constant human supervision, unlike traditional chatbots or rule-based automation.

AI agents have autonomy and awareness to carry out complex tasks independently, while traditional automation follows fixed rules and requires human oversight for each decision point.
